comment: amd-rig SDR HITL bench catalog (read by hitl-reserved --catalog on the amd64 //pi/hitl:hitl_sdr variant). Unlike the fleet-identical Pi catalog.json, this host offers ONE composite reservable unit: TWO ESP32-C6s wired next to a HackRF One, handed out together as a single atomic reservation for reverse-engineering the ESP32's lower-layer WiFi/BT stacks (two C6s enable TX/RX-between-DUTs experiments; the HackRF is the on-air oracle). No auto-discovery (discovery yields single-board units, not composites) and no FX2 analyzer / provisioning-AP (see nix/hitl-sdr.nix). host/workspace + the unit sshd port range are passed as flags by nix/hitl-sdr.nix, not baked here.

components.comment: Primary ESP32-C6 DUT (DUT 0), addressed by its built-in USB-JTAG by-id symlink (stable across re-enumeration) and pinned to /dev/ttyACM0. HITL_TTY + HITL_ADAPTER_SERIAL name DUT 0 for the in-container toolbox; the default (no --dut) resolves here, so single-DUT usage is unchanged.
components.name: c6-0

components.comment: Second ESP32-C6 DUT (DUT 1), pinned to /dev/ttyACM1. Uses the suffixed env keys HITL_TTY_1 / HITL_ADAPTER_SERIAL_1 (distinct from DUT 0, so the daemon injects both without collision). Address it from the toolbox with `--dut 1` (hitl-monitor/flash/jtag/gdb) or `hitl-devices` to list the mapping.
components.name: c6-1

components.comment: The HackRF One. A raw-USB SDR with no serial tty, so it isn't isolated by the tty→USB-port path; the reservation container runs privileged (single-unit bench) and sees the whole /dev/bus/usb, which includes the HackRF at 1d50:6089. hackrf_info + GNU Radio/gr-osmosdr in the env drive it.
components.name: sdr-0

units.comment: The composite unit: TWO C6s + HackRF reserved together as one atomic unit for lower-layer RE (two C6s enable TX/RX-between-DUTs experiments; the HackRF is the on-air oracle). Its capabilities are the union of the components (flash/monitor/jtag/gdb + sdr/rx/tx/wideband). Target it with `hitl reserve --type esp32c6+hackrf` or `--unit c6-sdr` (both unchanged — the second C6 joins the same unit, not a new type). In-container: default toolbox commands act on DUT 0 (ttyACM0); use `--dut 1` for the second C6, and `hitl-devices` to list both. pin_only: these C6s are SDR-hardwired (wired to the HackRF, no antenna) and this is the only such bench, so it must NOT absorb ordinary caps-only work — e.g. the netstack/vendor tests that reserve 'any DUT with flash+improv+wss-app' would otherwise match it and steal the SDR bench. pin_only makes it reachable ONLY by an explicit target (its unit name or the esp32c6+hackrf type, both of which the SDR reservations use); a bare caps-only/any request skips it. See engine eligible(): by-name and by-type opt past pin-only, caps-only gets !PinOnly.
units.name: c6-sdr
